inspiration: Palette-style texture animation: water, lava, gold and dirt tiles each use a frame list of about eight frames, with repeats to vary hold time so a seam glints unevenly (config/fxdata/textureanim.toml:13-30).
Team recolour from one base sprite: one base set plus per-player colour variants keeps the art budget small (config/fxdata/spritecolors.toml:2-3).
Creatures as readable stat sheets with named fields for health, armour, fear, hunger, lair size and base speed (config/creatrs/dragon.cfg:1-25).
Clipbox as a first-class value: body box plus a tall Z value (config/creatrs/dragon.cfg:24-25), useful for collision and framing.
Campaign override folders: each campaign ships its own creature configs in a sibling *_crtr folder (campgns/dzjr06lv_crtr).
Text maps with REM headers for author and version: plain-text levels that are easy to diff and hand-author (levels/classic/map00206.txt:1-10).
Lua hooks expose rules for triggers and classes (config/fxdata/lua/classes, config/fxdata/lua/triggers).

briefs.label: Gold glint seam (own label)
briefs.why: a bright metal seam that shimmers unevenly reads as precious without extra geometry
briefs.keep: short frame loop; repeated frames to vary hold time
briefs.change: our own warm bronze ramp; different loop length; specular sweep instead of frame swaps

briefs.label: Team-colour kit (own label)
briefs.why: one master sprite set serves every team
briefs.keep: base set plus palette variants per team
briefs.change: our own team hues and trim motifs; add a shape badge so colour is not the only cue

briefs.label: Armoured brute (own label)
briefs.why: very high health, high armour and low movement read as a boss threat
briefs.keep: high health, low base speed, tall clipbox
briefs.change: our own horned silhouette without wings; different fear and hunger profile; our own palette

briefs.label: Eight-frame lava loop (own label)
briefs.why: a hot floor that cycles reads as moving without costly effects
briefs.keep: short loop with a glow edge
briefs.change: our own ember ramp and crust pattern; light pulse on nearby walls

briefs.label: Stat-sheet creature template (own label)
briefs.why: named numeric fields make creatures easy to tune and compare
briefs.keep: attribute block per creature with a clipbox line
briefs.change: our own field names and ranges; add sound and colour cue fields
